title: pleurogramme intermedia
intro: Pleurogramme intermedia, commonly known as the intermediate rock cap moss, is a species of liverwort that belongs to the family Pleuroziaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Pleurogramme intermedia include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and antifungal activities, making it a potential natural remedy for wound healing and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Pleurogramme intermedia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
